name: Payments behaviour
description: Authorizing a payment, capturing it shipment by shipment, voiding it, and refunding part of it. Every effect on the processor is external.

roles.name: Shopper
roles.description: A person buying from the store.

roles.name: Merchant
roles.description: The store that sells, ships and refunds the order.

roles.name: Customer care lead
roles.description: The merchant's person who approves a refund the merchant does not grant on sight.

roles.name: Payment reviewer
roles.description: The merchant's person who reviews a large capture before the money is taken. An organization may give the role to an agent in its fleet.

actions.name: Authorize
actions.description: Ask the processor to hold an amount against an order. A declined authorization creates no payment, so the Action moves no state; the answer is its output.

actions.name: Capture
actions.description: Collect the part of the authorized amount that one shipment carries. More shipments are to follow.

actions.name: Capture final
actions.description: Collect what the last shipment carries, and close the authorization.

actions.name: Void
actions.description: Release an authorization that will not be captured.

actions.name: Request refund
actions.description: Ask for part of a captured payment back.

actions.name: Issue refund
actions.description: Return a requested refund to the shopper through the processor.

actions.name: Decline refund
actions.description: Refuse a requested refund, with the reason the shopper is told.

operations.name: Shopper requests a refund
operations.description: The shopper asks for money back on a shipment.

workflows.name: Refund
workflows.description: One refund, from the shopper's request to issued or declined, run on its own after the purchase has ended.

policies.description: A capture above 10000 is routed to the payment reviewer rather than performed, whether or not more shipments follow.
Issuing a refund needs the customer-care lead's approval when it is above 200, or when the reason is not one the merchant accepts on sight.
